messages:
alex: heads up — AcmeCorp reporting intermittent 500s + high latency on POST /v1/generate (hosted). Customer gave request_id=req_abc123 and gateway id gw-9f7a. They say python sdk v0.9.2, latency ~5–10s then 500. Need minimal repro + debug bundle. :warning:

support-bot: Ticket #SUP-4721 created for req_abc123

maria: can you grab the raw curl they used (headers + body) and ask for a minimal sdk snippet for py/js/go? also need the full X-Redwood-Request and any gateway trace ids.

alex: customer sent this curl (api key masked):

```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

alex: headers they logged: X-Redwood-Request: req_abc123  | X-Gateway-Id: gw-9f7a  | time: 2026-03-16T17:18:42Z

maria: perfect. @eng-oncall can you look for gw-9f7a / req_abc123 in infra logs between 17:17–17:21 UTC? paste matching lines if possible. if logs are sensitive, just give the error class and trace id.

eng-oncall: pulled logs — looks like transient backend timeout. snippet:

[2026-03-16T17:18:42Z] req=req_abc123 level=error backend=grpc service=model-serving timeout=12.0s trace=trace-55b msg="upstream timeout, retried once"
[2026-03-16T17:18:42Z] req=req_abc123 level=warn routing=pool-2 selected_variant=gpt-4o-mini-q8 msg="fallback to slower host after retry"

eng-oncall: trace id is trace-55b. backend returned 504 after 12s, then our gateway converted to 500 in the edge path. request looks like it hit a slow kv-cache miss.

maria: good, that aligns. alex — please ask customer to run a quick minimal repro we can validate. share these minimal SDK snippets (py/js/go) so they can paste and run. also ask for SDK version, OS, region, and whether they use custom retry/backoff.

alex: sending minimal repro snippets now:

Python (requests):
```
import requests
r = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate",
  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Request-Id": "req_abc123"},
  json={"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"},
  timeout=15
)
print(r.status_code, r.text)
```

JavaScript (node, fetch):
```
// node 18+
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Request-Id': 'req_abc123' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', input: 'hello' }),
  timeout: 15000
})
console.log(res.status, await res.text())
```

Go (minimal):
```
package main
import (
  "bytes"; "context"; "fmt"; "net/http"; "os"; "time"
)
func main(){
  ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
  defer cancel()
  req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}`))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  req.Header.Set("X-Request-Id","req_abc123")
  resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  if err!=nil { fmt.Println("err:",err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println("status:",resp.Status)
}
```

alex: also ask them to run our debug helper if they can: `redwood-debug collect --request-id req_abc123 --include-logs --tail 200` and attach the archive. if they are unable, ask for a HAR or tcpdump.

ben: I reproduced locally with a small Go test — got a 504 from backend, then 500 at the gateway. snippet I used (short):
```
// go test helper
ctx, _ := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewBufferString(body))
req.Header.Set("X-Request-Id","req_abc123")
resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
fmt.Println(resp.Status)
```

eng-oncall: next steps: 1) ask customer to run one of the above minimal scripts as-is (no custom retries). 2) collect debug bundle / HAR. 3) if repro happens, include exact timestamp + their account/region + SDK version and attach bundle to SUP-4721. I'll correlate trace-55b with backend host.

maria: i'll message the customer template: short ask + attach these snippets + exact command for debug collect.

alex: sending customer message now. awaiting results. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving this open until we get the debug bundle. ping here when they attach.
